policy: Regional terrain packages are generated from modern Copernicus GLO-30 DSM source data. They become production-ready only after the live GitHub terrain workflow verifies source objects, builds lossless Terrain-RGB PMTiles, validates the archive, and the hosted URL passes browser Range/CORS diagnostics.

regions.label: Jerusalem / Judea
regions.verification: GitHub Actions performs a live HTTP byte-range + TIFF signature check before download/build; research-supplied HTTP metadata is not trusted as proof.
regions.notes: Research-supplied tile target only. The alpha.12 local 3D site geometry works without this DEM, but regional relief remains flat until a valid Terrain-RGB PMTiles archive is configured.

regions.label: Galilee / Sea of Galilee
regions.verification: GitHub Actions performs a live HTTP byte-range + TIFF signature check before download/build; research-supplied HTTP metadata is not trusted as proof.
regions.notes: Modern DSM target. A c. 30 CE shoreline is a separate historical-inference layer and must not be inferred directly from modern water extent.

regions.label: Megiddo / Jezreel Valley
regions.verification: GitHub Actions performs a live HTTP byte-range + TIFF signature check before download/build; research-supplied HTTP metadata is not trusted as proof.
regions.notes: Shares the research-supplied Copernicus target tile with Galilee. Tel-scale archaeological topography requires a more precise source than GLO-30 before it can be represented as measured micro-relief.

regions.label: Sinai Peninsula
regions.verification: GitHub Actions performs a live HTTP byte-range + TIFF signature check before download/build; research-supplied HTTP metadata is not trusted as proof.
regions.notes: The supplied research explicitly covers a larger 27–31 N / 32–35 E region but lists only four tiles. Do not treat this list as complete. The runtime must remain functional without a Sinai DEM.

regions.label: Eastern Nile Delta / Isthmus of Suez
regions.verification: GitHub Actions performs a live HTTP byte-range + TIFF signature check before download/build; research-supplied HTTP metadata is not trusted as proof.
regions.notes: Modern DSM can support broad relief only. Bronze-Age channels, lakes, marshes, and shorelines require a separately labeled historical-inference reconstruction. No Exodus crossing point may be encoded.
